scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,recommender "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web" "npm run dev:recommender"
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace apps/api && npm run check --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web
